familyFit.summary: Demonstrated mixed-facing three-across with positive cabin-space evidence; exact boosters remain untested.

familyFit.row3: No third row on this five-seat configuration.
familyFit.testedSeats: 2023 test: rear-facing InfaSecure Attain More plus forward-facing Achieve More and Attain More; an alternative two Achieve More plus one Attain More also fitted.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Three-booster daily buckle reach is untested. ANCAP found its Type A capsule and one selected booster could not be correctly installed centrally; its restraints were tested separately.
familyFit.access: BabyDrive found loading easy from inside/outside, but 2024 Long Range road test reports narrower rear door opening than RAV4, less square than Forester and less than 90-degree opening.
familyFit.ventilation: Rear console vents; verify airflow with your restraints fitted.

consumption.basis: 2024 original Long Range mandated Australian ADR 81/02 laboratory result reproduced by AAA from the Green Vehicle Guide. Converted from 169 Wh/km. Representative tested build, not every year/VIN in this group. The lab figure’s mains/battery boundary has not been separately verified here.

dcCharging.basis: Peak reported in Australian 2024 original Long Range road test; not sustained power. 2023 VIN-specific charging curve not measured here.

vehicleUpdates.chargeTime: AAA 2024 Long Range test: 19–100% in 6 h 9 min at an 11 kW AC charger. This is not a DC 10–80% claim.
gaps: Exact AWD-specific three-seat trial and pack gross/usable capacity remain unverified.
AAA consumption is for a February 2024-built original Long Range; weather, wheel specification and a late-2023 VIN can differ.
Australian plated towing and a VDA-comparable boot measure remain unverified.
pros: 533 km published WLTP range; AAA original Long Range test achieved 490 km.
AAA measured 16.7 kWh/100 km from the mains, including charging losses.
Related RWD body test supports spacious three-seat potential; confirm the AWD car.
cons: Original basic warranty is 4 years / 80,000 km.
Rear door opening is narrower than RAV4 in a first-hand road test.

observedRange.basis: Observed AAA test range, calculated under its recharge-energy procedure; not WLTP, not a full-to-empty household trial. expertReviews.tested: 2024 Tesla Model Y Long Range AWD
expertReviews.scope: Original Australian five-seat AWD road test; supports this generation, not a late-2023 VIN hardware cutover. Current page has converted the old numeric rating to a label.
positiveThemes: Smooth and efficient electric powertrain; useful cabin and cargo storage.
negativeThemes: Busy ride and road noise; price cuts hurt resale; rear doors open less widely than RAV4.

audit.summary: Updated restraint combinations, front-seat clearance, charging and measured energy use. Listing samples and repair budgets retain the limitations shown below.

items.finding: Re-read seven individual QLD asks: two 2023 RWD A$35,990–42,991 drive-away (26,101–87,987 km); two 2023 LR A$42,500 excluding charges/A$48,998 drive-away (55,449–73,500 km); three new Premium RWD A$62,918–64,448 drive-away, 12 km. Points remain A$39,491/A$45,749/A$64,448. Tiny, mixed-mileage samples; LR fees differ; build months and availability need confirmation. Corrected RWD geography to the two included dealers.

Closed observed-consumption gaps with AAA: original 2024 LR 16.7 kWh/100 km and Juniper 2025 RWD 14.8, both measured from mains including charging losses. Observed ranges 490/450 km stay distinct from 533/466 km lab claims. Added LR 250 kW / refreshed RWD 175 kW reported DC peaks. Original RWD 15.9 remains a separate road-test observation. Battery gross/usable reports and en_au towing text conflict; no invented pack/tow figure. Lab and road-test use are separate: original LR 16.9 vs 16.7; Juniper RWD 15.3 vs 14.8 kWh/100km. Original RWD 15.9 is road-test only, with unknown boundary.

Both generations demonstrate mixed-facing three-across. Original RWD has named seats, 186 cm driver clearance and flat floor; refreshed RWD reports about 180 cm. Exact LR restraint test is absent. Cabin room and door access differ: original LR review says rear aperture narrower than RAV4. Both ANCAP reports identify a centre booster/capsule incompatibility. Three-booster buckle access stays unknown.

Original 2022–2025 basic cover 4 years/80,000 km; 2026 deliveries 5 years/unlimited normal-use kilometres, no retrospective restart. RWD battery/drive unit 8 years/160,000 km, LR 8 years/192,000 km, 70% retention. Balance transfers; extra used-car cover is only Tesla Certified Pre-Owned. Repair-parts cover and exclusions are separate.

Rechecked original-body schedule: brake-fluid health check four years, cabin filters two, HEPA/carbon three, tyre rotation 10,000 km/uneven wear. No compulsory annual Tesla package. A$350/year remains an optional maintenance estimate (200–500), supported only by a specialist from-A$199 offer and periodic work; VIN-specific quote required. Historical road-test two-year brake-fluid advice differs from current manual.

Insurance rechecked 18 October 2026: A$2,260/year planning budget; A$1,540–4,500 sensitivity, not guaranteed quotes. National model mean · mixed years and variants. Original Model Y RWD retains its explicit A$2,000 user-set default. No unsupported SUV loading. Your drivers, excess, insured value and cover still need a quote; CTP is separate.

Budget aftermarket audit, 18 October 2026. 255/45R19 104Y XL replacement reference: A$1,000 for four fitted. Common 40,000 km life is an illustrative assumption, not model-specific wear evidence. Prices and annual savings are estimates; check the real placard and local fitted quote.

No representative Australian annual paid-repair average found. Preserve A$1,000/year original-body and A$700 newer Juniper savings funds, low confidence. Rechecked A$1,823 fitted upper-arm pair and indicative A$2,000–4,000+ compressor guide. TÜV inspection defects and ADAC roadside breakdowns measure different events and cannot become annual Australian repair dollars. Official VIN-applicable software recalls have remedies; recall counts are not owner-paid replacement bills.

Opened ProductReview page still displays 4.4/5 from 30 mixed-year/variant contributions; not verified-owner-only or a reliability survey. Search snippet 4.5 is not substituted for the read page. Added exact original LR CarExpert categorical verdict. Keep Juniper CarsGuide 7.4/10 scoped to launch RWD; current warranty/safety supersede historical review text.

Confirmed QLD BEV private annual rego + Class 1 CTP A$782.15–798.15 (midpoint A$790.15), separate comprehensive insurance, and A$2/$100 EV duty below A$100,000. Original/Juniper ANCAP scopes differ. Body width is not cabin fit; Tesla cargo litres are not VDA. Australian plated towing and VIN-specific late-2023 suspension/hardware cutover remain unresolved. Inspect pack underside, suspension noise, HVAC, AC/DC charging, tyre inner edges and warranty/recall completion.
